'''Ola Rosling''' (born 1 November 1975) is a [[Swedish people|Swedish]] statistician known for his work for the [[Gapminder Foundation]] on changing the global quality of life. He is the chairman, director and co-founder of the foundation.<ref>{{Cite web|title = Staff|url=http://www.gapminder.org/about-gapminder/staff/|publisher = [[Gapminder Foundation]]|accessdate = 27 September 2015}}</ref>

==Career==
Rosling co-founded the Gapminder Foundation together with his wife [[Anna Rosling Rönnlund]] and his father [[Hans Rosling]]. Ola led the development of the [[Trendalyzer]] software that creates interactive graphics from statistical datasets.<ref>{{Cite news|title = At home: statistician Hans Rosling|url=https://www.ft.com/content/31eb93be-a80e-11e2-8e5d-00144feabdc0|newspaper = [[Financial Times]]|date = 26 April 2013|access-date = 27 September 2015|issn = 0307-1766|first = Annie Maccoby|last = Berglof}}</ref> The software was bought by [[Google]] in 2007<ref>{{Cite web|title = A world in motion|url=http://googleblog.blogspot.fi/2007/03/world-in-motion.html|accessdate = 27 September 2015|website = [[Google Blog]]}}</ref> and Rosling and his team worked for Google from then on. He became Google's Public Data product manager.<ref>{{Cite web|title = Ola Rosling|url=https://www.ted.com/speakers/ola_rosling|publisher=[[TED (conference)|TED]]|accessdate = 27 September 2015}}</ref>

[[File:Anna Rosling Rönnlund, Hans Rosling, and Ola Rosling on "Factfulness".jpg|thumb|Left to right: Anna Rosling Rönnlund, Hans Rosling, and Ola Rosling discuss their book "Factfulness" in 2016.]]
<!-- "In 2018," it can't have happened in that year since the father Hans was not alive anymore then-->Ola and Anna Rosling collaborated with [[Hans Rosling]] and co-authored the book called ''[[Factfulness]].''<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bokus.com/bok/9781473637467/factfulness/|title=Factfulness av Hans Rosling, Ola Rosling, Anna Rosling Ronnlund (Bok)|website=Bokus.com|language=sv|access-date=10 January 2019}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=j-4yDwAAQBAJ|title=Factfulness: Ten Reasons We're Wrong About the World--and Why Things Are Better Than You Think|last1=Rosling|first1=Hans|last2=Rönnlund|first2=Anna Rosling|last3=Rosling|first3=Ola|date=3 April 2018|publisher=Flatiron Books|isbn=9781250123817|language=en}}</ref>
